V. BIOMETRIC PRIVACY & LOCAL RAM ZEROIZATION ADDENDUM

🛡️ Certified Compliance: Illinois BIPA (740 ILCS 14/), California CCPA/CPRA, and GLBA / HIPAA Safeguards

1. Volatile RAM-Only Execution: All biometric processing—including facial liveness verification, ocular topology, and voice acoustic stress analysis—executes strictly within volatile local system memory (RAM). Provider maintains zero capability, infrastructure, or network channels to access, collect, or store biometric identifiers of Licensee personnel or claimants.

2. Zero Persistent Biometric Storage: At no point is any facial video, voice recording, or biometric vector written, saved, or serialized to persistent solid-state disk (NVMe), database, or non-volatile storage.
